title: IVG Intense Salts Retro Cola 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: IVG Intense Salts Retro Cola recreates the familiar taste of classic Cola with a sweet and fizzy finish. The flavour is light and nostalgic, bringing together syrupy soda notes with a gentle sparkle that keeps the profile lively. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this Nic Salt provides smooth flavour delivery, discreet vapour, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, Retro Cola works best in mouth-to-lung (MTL) pod kits, pens and starter systems. Part of the IVG Intense Salts range, Retro Cola captures the taste of a timeless soft drink.
